_comment: Curation for PUBLIC repositories, keyed by repo name. Unlisted public repos still appear in the repository table with area 'misc'.

vidaio-subnet.blurb: Vidaio subnet (SN85): decentralized AI video upscaling and compression, with miners and validators scored on perceptual quality.

compress.blurb: Video compression toolkit: encoder wrapper, VMAF quality scoring, scene classification and a learned image-quality model.

natix_classifer.blurb: Image classifier training for the Natix network: multi-backbone runs (ConvNeXt, EfficientNet, ViT, Swin) over real and synthetic roadwork data.

ai.blurb: Docs and demos for face and fingerprint recognition, image captioning and encrypted face recognition.

liveweb_arena.blurb: Real-time evaluation framework for LLM browser agents on live websites (CoinGecko, Taostats, Stooq, weather), plus SFT dataset generation aligned with the benchmark.

swe_agent.blurb: GitHub-native patch agent: reads an issue or /patch comment, locates relevant files, generates edits with an LLM, commits a valid patch on a branch and opens a PR with CI checks.

mini_swe_agent_rl.blurb: Extension of mini-swe-agent, the 100-line SWE agent, for reinforcement learning from human and dataset trajectories.

agents_collection.blurb: LLM-driven and hand-written agents for AgentGym environments (SciWorld, TextCraft and more) on OpenAI-compatible APIs.

llm_agent_bitquant.blurb: Crypto-analysis LLM agent API that classifies queries into six categories (portfolio, yield farming, trading and more) and routes each to specialized tools.

kinitro-agent.blurb: Multi-task RL agent template for the Kinitro embodied-AI subnet: offline TD3+BC and online RL on MetaWorld MT50.

east_world.blurb: Eastworld (SN94): gyms for evaluating and training embodied, generally capable AI agents in an open virtual world.

mantis_miner.blurb: Miner for MANTIS (SN123): embeddings that help predict one-hour moves of financial instruments.

miid.blurb: Backend for MIID (SN54), the identity-testing subnet.

bitsec_subnet.blurb: BitSec: AI-powered vulnerability detection for subnet codebases and smart contracts, with backend.

checkerchain_endpoint.blurb: Scoring endpoint service for the CheckerChain subnet.

affine-dashboard.blurb: React + Node/Express dashboard for Affine (SN120) mining: sortable and filterable miner tables, auto-refresh and personal hotkey tracking.

Connito-AI.blurb: Subnet 102: collaborative, decentralized training of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs with expert groups spread across miners.

LLaMA-Factory.blurb: Fork of the unified fine-tuning framework for 100+ LLMs and VLMs, used for my SFT and LoRA runs.

DefiLlama-Adapters.blurb: DeFiLlama TVL adapter for the HyperLoan protocol.

bsty_extension.blurb: Open-source browser-extension wallet for Bitcoin NFTs.
